correctness.rationale: Full generation iff two-sided symbolic itineraries are distinct; on each n-cycle this is primitive word plus distinct rotation classes between equal-length cycles. Primitive necklaces via Möbius inversion give exact count. The parity term follows unique largest proper period n/2 for even n, and the birthday Poisson limit follows explicit factorial-moment graph estimates, conditional primitivity uniformity and tightness. Direct checker verified 339 permutation/rank cases and 10,999 tuples; limits of finite testing are disclosed.
